name: IndicGLUE
description: IndicGLUE is a benchmark suite for Indian language natural language understanding, comprising multiple datasets for tasks such as article genre classification, headline prediction, multiple choice QA, NLI, and others across 11 major Indian languages.
reputation: IndicGLUE is a well-known and widely used benchmark suite for evaluating multilingual and Indian-language NLU models.
notes: Includes large-scale monolingual corpora, pre-trained embeddings and language models, and multiple NLU evaluation datasets for Indian languages.
